quarterly_data.signal: Product launch: Hamamatsu Photonics developed the iPHEMOS-DDX inverted emission microscope for failure analysis of advanced semiconductor packages, including AI chiplets, High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), 2.5D/3D and large-scale packages, integrating into existing tester-based measurement setups; orders accepted from September 29, 2026 from semiconductor manufacturers and semiconductor equipment manufacturers worldwide.
